Final-round prep plan for Lincoln International, analyst role:

Timeline
- 3 days out: review the Lincoln International posting and their recent deals or public news so you can name two or three things they do. Map your past work to the analyst skills the posting asks for.
- 2 days out: write four stories with a number each (situation, what you did, result). Cover a time you led analysis under a deadline, a time you were wrong and corrected it, a conflict with a teammate, and why this firm.
- 1 day out: practice out loud, twice. Time each answer to about 2 minutes.
- Day of: have the interviewer names, the format, and your questions ready.
Topics to cover for an analyst role
- Financial modeling and valuation basics, if the posting asks for them
- Case-style or market-sizing questions
- Your résumé's strongest project, walked through end to end
- Why this firm and why this role

What to practice
- Your "walk me through your résumé" answer, under 90 seconds
- Two or three stories with numbers, as above
- Three questions to ask them about team, deal flow and first-year expectations
